recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reopen FHIR-25060 for current FHIR core source; any future removal of the commented-out CareTeam ctm-1 block should be a separate editorial cleanup, not this applied CarePlan tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-25060 was Published/Persuasive and requested correcting an invariant described against CarePlan so that unresolved member references would not fail the Practitioner type check.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioned FHIR-25060. Commit 019e2dd719b6415309a6c1ef0a8e5d176b409251 appears to have applied the exact expression change in the old CareTeam spreadsheet, changing member.resolve() is Practitioner to member.resolve().iif(empty(), true, ofType(Practitioner).exists()).
additional_context: The Jira comment and the #fhir/infrastructure-wg FHIR-25060 Zulip thread both record that CarePlan.onBehalfOf no longer exists. Current CarePlan source is active in fhir.ini but has no onBehalfOf/member.resolve invariant. Later Applied issue FHIR-42928 broadened CareTeam.participant.onBehalfOf and explicitly removed the matching CareTeam invariant, implemented by ad2f38e1c73d13f4f5c352de9392f4300892ffa2 and 18388d3b9a820693ebe675fbaddb23f17a904711.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the faulty constraint is absent from current CarePlan source and the old CareTeam ctm-1 copy is only in an XML comment.
